title: Satyabhama
desc: ACP Satyabhama embarks on an investigation into a missing person case, which leads her to uncover dark secrets hidden within the town. However, as she delves deeper, her past begins to haunt her.

title: Singam II
desc: Durai Singam, a policeman working an undercover operation, attempts to eliminate a drug trafficking ring in the coastal town of Thoothukudi.

title: Alangu
desc: While trying to cross over to Kerala, a Tamil tribal boy and his group of friends get drawn into communal clashes that erupt along the state border.

title: Crazy Gopalan
desc: Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.

title: Chakra
desc: A carefully planned mass robbery causes a police officer and a soldier to team up with each other and carry out an investigation, which reveals a vast syndicate of cybercriminals.
